propositions: The close precheck scans historical commit messages and calls resolve_ticket_id for every extracted reference, causing ambiguity diagnostics from unrelated tickets to print to stderr.
Ambiguous short prefixes in historical commits trigger 'Ambiguous prefix matches multiple tickets' errors even though the scan correctly detects valid full-ID references elsewhere.

The resolver prints ambiguity diagnostics directly to stderr regardless of context, making it impossible for internal callers like _referencing_commit_exists to suppress noise while preserving diagnostics for user-facing commands.
Adding a quiet parameter to resolve_ticket_id gates the three stderr ambiguity prints while preserving normal diagnostics for explicit user-supplied ambiguous prefixes.
Close precheck gate semantics are unaffected by suppressing ambiguity diagnostics because resolve_ticket_id returns None for ambiguous cases regardless.
